# Vocational Education FAQs & Parent Concern Guidance

## Income and Financial Stability
Vocational training courses (ITI & PMKVY) provide practical skills that lead to early employment within 6 to 12 months. Starting monthly salaries range between ₹15,000 to ₹23,500 depending on trade and location. Trainees achieve financial independence earlier than traditional general degree graduates.

## Social Perception & Respect
NSQF certifications are recognized by the Government of India, Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship (MSDE). Skilled technicians hold respected technical roles in public and private enterprises, manufacturing plants, solar installations, and infrastructure projects.

## Safety and Working Conditions
Government ITIs follow strict safety regulations (OSHA standards, personal protective equipment, safety gear). Modern industrial workplaces prioritize worker safety with mandatory protective helmets, safety glasses, and automated machine guards.

## Career Growth and Lateral Entry
Vocational training is not a dead end. Under the National Credit Framework (NCrF), ITI graduates can take lateral entry into the 2nd year of Polytechnic Diploma courses (NSQF Level 5) and subsequently pursue B.Tech or B.Voc degrees.
